shellCommands.command: pwd && git status --short && git log --oneline | head -5 && ls -la && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -200

for f in package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts index.html .gitignore src/App.tsx src/main.tsx src/vite-env.d.ts; do echo "===== $f"; cat "$f"; echo; done; echo "===== run.mjs"; head -c 3000 __agent_eval__/run.mjs; echo; echo "===== node_modules"; ls node_modules | head -100; ls node_modules | wc -l; node -v; npm -v

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui node_modules/@uiw node_modules/@hello-pangea node_modules/@tanstack 2>/dev/null; echo ---; grep -n '"node_modules/[^"]*charts[^"]*"\|"node_modules/[^"]*echarts[^"]*"\|"node_modules/[^"]*uplot[^"]*"\|"node_modules/[^"]*chart[^"]*"' package-lock.json | head -40; echo ---; grep -n '"node_modules/@gravity-ui/' package-lock.json | head -60; echo ---; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'; cat node_modules/react/package.json | grep '"version"'; cat node_modules/vite/package.json | grep '"version"'; cat node_modules/typescript/package.json | grep '"version"'

cd /tmp && timeout 60 npm view @gravity-ui/charts version peerDependencies dependencies 2>&1 | head -60; echo ---; timeout 60 npm view uplot version 2>&1 | head -5; timeout 60 npm view uplot@latest dist.unpackedSize 2>&1 | head -3

cd /tmp && timeout 60 npm view @gravity-ui/charts versions --json 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\n ' | head -c 2000; echo; for v in 1.x; do :; done; timeout 60 npm view @gravity-ui/charts@1 peerDependencies --json 2>/dev/null | tail -20; timeout 60 npm view @gravity-ui/charts@1 version 2>/dev/null | tail -3

D=/tmp/claude-1000/bundled-skills/2.1.318/27765189b1f261b3c07a35e4626f68a2/dataviz; ls $D/scripts; echo "== light, slots 1-3 all pairs"; node $D/scripts/validate_palette.js "#2a78d6,#eb6834,#1baf7a" --mode light --pairs all; echo "exit=$?"; echo "== dark, slots 1-3 all pairs"; node $D/scripts/validate_palette.js "#3987e5,#d95926,#199e70" --mode dark --surface "#1a1a19" --pairs all; echo "exit=$?"; echo "== light, 4 slots adjacent"; node $D/scripts/validate_palette.js "#2a78d6,#eb6834,#1baf7a,#eda100" --mode light; echo "exit=$?"

timeout 400 npm install @gravity-ui/charts@1.73.0 uplot@1.6.32 2>&1 | tail -15; echo "exit=$?"; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/package.json | grep -E '"(version|main|module|types)"' ; cat node_modules/uplot/package.json | grep -E '"(version|main|module|types|exports)"'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/ | head; git diff --stat
git diff package.json; D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm; ls $D | head -50; echo ---; cat $D/index.d.ts | head -80; echo ---; grep -rl "export.*Chart\b" $D --include=*.d.ts | head -20

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm; cat $D/components/index.d.ts; echo ---; ls $D/components; echo ---; cat $D/components/Chart/Chart.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60; echo "--- types:"; ls $D/types;

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm; grep -rn "export interface ChartData\b\|export type ChartData\b" $D --include=*.d.ts | head; F=$(grep -rln "export interface ChartData\b\|export type ChartData\b" $D --include=*.d.ts | head -1); echo "file=$F"; grep -n "ChartData" -A25 "$F" | head -80

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm; F=$D/core/types/index.d.ts; sed -n 66,140p $F; echo ....; grep -n "xAxis\|yAxis\|series\|tooltip\|legend\|grid\|export interface\|export type" $F | head -80
D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types; ls $D $D/chart; echo ---; cat $D/chart/series.d.ts | head -150

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart; cat $D/line.d.ts | head -120; echo ---AXIS; grep -n "export interface ChartXAxis\|export interface ChartYAxis\|type:\|categories\|min\|max\|labels\|dateTime\|format" $D/axis.d.ts | head -60; echo ---LEGEND; sed -n 1,40p $D/legend.d.ts | grep -n "enabled\|layout\|position\|interactive"

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts; sed -n 1,20p $D/dist/esm/core/types/chart/axis.d.ts; grep -n "type?:\|type:" $D/dist/esm/core/types/chart/axis.d.ts | head; echo ---; node -e "const p=require('./$D/package.json'); console.log(JSON.stringify({exports:p.exports, sideEffects:p.sideEffects, style:p.style, files:p.files}, null, 1))" | head -60; echo ---; grep -rn "xAxis\|datetime" $D/README.md | head -20

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm; grep -rn "AXIS_TYPE = \|SERIES_TYPE = " -A8 $D/core/constants* 2>/dev/null | head -30; grep -rln "AXIS_TYPE" $D/core/constants* 2>/dev/null | head -3; echo ---UIKIT; U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit; ls $U/build 2>/dev/null | head -3; grep -o "useThemeType\|SegmentedRadioGroup\|Card\b\|Table\b\|Text\b\|Label\b\|Divider\|Hint" $U/build/esm/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | sort -u; ls $U

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit; ls $U/build/esm | head -5; grep -rl "useThemeType" $U/build/esm --include=*.d.ts | head -3; grep -h "export" $U/build/esm/index.d.ts | head -5; grep -c "" $U/build/esm/index.d.ts; grep -o "SegmentedRadioGroup\|useThemeType\|\bCard\b\|\bTable\b\|\bText\b\|\bSkeleton\b\|\bSpin\b\|\bLoader\b\|\bDivider\b" $U/build/esm/index.d.ts | sort | uniq -c; grep -rn "export.*useThemeType\|export.*\bSegmentedRadioGroup\b" $U/build/esm --include=*.d.ts | head -4

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; cat $U/theme/useThemeType.d.ts; sed -n 1,40p $U/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts; ls $U | tr '\n' ' '; echo; cat $U/Card/Card.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types; grep -n "ValueFormat\b" -A12 $D/chart/base.d.ts | head -40; echo ---; grep -n "export interface ChartTooltip\b" -A30 $D/chart/tooltip.d.ts | grep -n "enabled\|format\|shared\|valueFormat\|headerFormat" ; echo ---; grep -n "export interface ChartAxisLabels" -A20 $D/chart/axis.d.ts | grep -n "format\|enabled"; echo ---; grep -n "export interface ChartLegend\b" -A12 $D/chart/legend.d.ts | head -20; echo; grep -n "lang" node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/components/index.d.ts

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types; grep -n "CustomFormat\b\|CustomFormat<\|export interface CustomFormatContext\|export type CustomFormat" -A6 $D/formatter.d.ts | head -40; grep -n "export interface NumberFormat\|export type NumberFormat" -A6 $D/formatter.d.ts | head -12; echo ---; grep -n "ChartTooltip<T>\|export interface ChartTooltip" -A6 $D/chart/tooltip.d.ts | head -20

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types; grep -rn "CustomFormat\b" $D --include=*.d.ts | head -5; F=$(grep -rln "export type CustomFormat\b\|export interface CustomFormat\b" $D --include=*.d.ts | head -1); echo "F=$F"; grep -n "CustomFormat\b" -B2 -A10 "$F" | head -50

sed -n 1,17p node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/base.d.ts | grep -n "CustomFormatContext" -A4; grep -rn "ThemeType" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/types.d.ts; node -e "const p=require('./node_modules/uplot/package.json'); console.log(JSON.stringify({main:p.main,module:p.module,types:p.types,exports:p.exports,style:p.style},null,1))"; ls node_modules/uplot/dist | head -20; which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; npm ls -g --depth=0 2>/dev/null | grep -i playwright
timeout 300 npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -60; echo "tsc exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
grep -n "export interface ChartAxisLabels" -A40 node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/axis.d.ts | grep -v "^\S*-\s*\*" | head -30

sed -n 40,200p node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/axis.d.ts | grep -n "^    [a-zA-Z]*?\?:" ; grep -n "formatter\|format?:" node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/axis.d.ts | head

grep -n "export interface FormatNumberOptions" -A60 node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/formatter.d.ts | grep -E "^\S+-    [a-zA-Z]+\??:" ; grep -n "export interface FormatNumberOptions" -B2 -A3 node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/formatter.d.ts | head; grep -n "NumberFormat\b" -A8 node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/base.d.ts | head -20

grep -rn "interface FormatNumberOptions" node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm --include=*.d.ts | head -3; F=$(grep -rln "interface FormatNumberOptions" node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm --include=*.d.ts | head -1); grep -n "interface FormatNumberOptions" -A80 "$F" | grep -E "^[0-9]+-    [a-zA-Z]+\??:" | head -30
timeout 300 npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | head -60; echo "tsc exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
timeout 400 npx vite build 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | tail -40; echo "--- tests"; timeout 300 npx vitest run 2>&1 | tail -40

mkdir -p /tmp/viz-check && cd /tmp/viz-check && timeout 300 npm init -y >/dev/null 2>&1; timeout 400 npm install playwright@1 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | tail -3; timeout 400 npx playwright install chromium 2>&1 | tail -5; echo "exit=$?"; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null
(npx vite --port 5173 --strictPort --host 127.0.0.1 > /tmp/viz-check/vite.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 6; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:5173/; tail -5 /tmp/viz-check/vite.log
(ps aux | grep -i "vite\|node" | grep -v grep | head -10); echo ---; curl -s http://127.0.0.1:5173/ | head -20; echo; curl -s http://127.0.0.1:5173/src/App.tsx | head -5
cd /tmp/viz-check && timeout 240 node shot.mjs 2>&1 | tail -40; ls -la /tmp/viz-check/*.png 2>/dev/null

id -u; (sudo -n true 2>&1 && echo SUDO_OK) || echo NO_SUDO; (command -v apt-get >/dev/null && echo has_apt); ls /usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu 2>/dev/null | grep -i "glib\|libnss3" | head -3; ls /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu 2>/dev/null | grep -i "libglib-2" | head -2; find / -name "libglib-2.0.so*" 2>/dev/null | head -3
rm -rf dist && git status --short && echo --- && timeout 120 npm audit --omit=dev 2>/dev/null | tail -4; echo ---; git stash list | head -1; git show --stat HEAD | head -5
